title: ATM and Foreign Fees a Reversed Advantage Claim Is Due, Paystride Visa Payroll Card
content:
On the Paystride Visa Payroll Card Advantage plan, the Paystride fees a reversed lost or stolen card claim is due follow the claimed transaction.

- When Paystride fees were charged on it (an out-of-network ATM fee, an international ATM fee or a foreign transaction fee), they count less any part of them already returned by refund or correction.
- When it is a withdrawal at a domestic out-of-network ATM that carried no out-of-network ATM fee because it was one of its pay period's free withdrawals, the Advantage out-of-network ATM withdrawal fee of 1.95 counts for the free withdrawal it used.
- Otherwise nothing counts.

For a claim whose reversal the claim reversal schedule for the Advantage plan prices, and only for such a claim, the fees counted in what the claim is due are settled by that reversal and not corrected again. A fee counted in what a claim is due under the claim reversal schedule for the Advantage plan, and only such a fee, is not corrected again. The other lost or stolen card claim schedules of the Paystride Visa Payroll Card Account state their own.

*Hypothetical cases:* an ATM withdrawal outside the United States carrying an international ATM fee of 2.50 and a foreign transaction fee of 3.15, neither returned, makes the claim due 5.65 in fees. A domestic in-network withdrawal makes it due nothing.
